title: Sign of binary parity
statement: For a subset $S$ of the coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define its binary parity sign function on $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ by sending $x$ to the sign encoding of the sum, modulo $2$, of the coordinates of $x$ indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite subset $S$ of the coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
